mentions.name: IoT RF Lightning Detector
mentions.description: A redesigned RF lightning detector rebuilt as a smaller, cheaper surface-mount IoT device, with PCBs planned to be ordered soon. It detects lightning storms ahead of their arrival, intended to be mounted on a motorbike to warn of approaching heavy storms in Southeast Asia, where no Blitzortung-style detection network exists.
mentions.problem: There is no lightning detection network like Blitzortung in Southeast Asia, so there is no way to detect lightning storms before they hit; driving a motorbike in heavy storms is a necessary but miserable part of life there.
mentions.source_excerpt: I redesigned it to be much smaller and cheaper (surface-mount), made it an IoT device, and various other changes. Will order PCBs in a bit, hopefully it works well.
